title: haven: mimi-hubd ignores keyMaterial requiredCapabilities and returns incompatible KeyPackages
description: Seen live 2026-11-14 ~17:30Z at the IETF 127 table. mimid-chat (78b0c16) asked mimi.havenmessenger.com (edd3ba1) for erin's key material with requiredCapabilities = extension 0x0006 and proposal 0x0008. The hub returned a success KeyPackage with openmls default capabilities (from Haven's examples/seed_fixtures.rs), and openmls refused the Add ('capabilities of the add proposal are insufficient'). In Haven's source, protocol_wire.rs decodes required_capabilities, but nothing under mimi-hubd/src reads it, so the hub never filters. -07 §5.2 defines noCompatibleMaterial and nothingCompatible against the request's requiredCapabilities, so a filtering hub should have answered one of them. Not in Haven's DIVERGENCES.md at edd3ba1. Cost: each attempt used up one of erin's KeyPackages (20 -> 17 after the probe and two invites). Report on #mimi or interop#1 only with Mark's OK.
